header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH, KARACHI
Date Order with signature of Judge
1. For order as to non-prosecution of main case
2. For order on CMA No.5686/2025 (For withdrawal of petition)
body: --------------------- Since inception of the case when the notice was issued on 07.8.2025, the counsel for the petitioner was not bothered to remove the office objection to pay the cost so that notice could be issued. However, in the meanwhile, the petitioner has filed an application bearing CMA No.5686 of 2025 for withdrawal of instant petition, which is hereby allowed. This petition stands dismissed as withdrawn. JUDGE Zahid/*
